source: Requested short lesson on customer offers, expanded at learner request to numbers
lessonTheme: Customer offers, recipient para and prices with 200 plus tens and units
summary: Formal cree was valid but differed from requested tú; crea and recipient para were then reused correctly. Soporte técnico spelling needed correction. Correct price statements used 200 in digits, then doscientos cincuenta and doscientos cincuenta y ocho after models. Learner requested numbers in everyday conversational practice.

observations.learnerText: cree una oferta por nuestros clientes, por favor
observations.correctedText: Crea una oferta para nuestros clientes, por favor.
observations.outcome: Cree is a valid formal usted command, but tú was requested. Recipient por corrected to para.

observations.learnerText: crea una oferta para nuestros clientes por favor
observations.correctedText: Crea una oferta para nuestros clientes, por favor.
observations.outcome: Correctly reused crea and para after correction; repeated the plural sentence rather than requested a new customer. Turn interrupted before tutor feedback; no new correction inferred.

observations.learnerText: crea una oferta para nuestro cliente nuevo por favor
observations.correctedText: Crea una oferta para nuestro cliente nuevo, por favor.
observations.outcome: Correct grammar and immediate reuse of crea and para. Nuestro means our rather than requested a; tutor acknowledged the valid meaning.
Incluye and offer sentence correct after model. Soporto technico corrected to soporte técnico; no corrected spelling retry observed.
Correct complete price statement after phrase model, using digits. Learner then explicitly requested number practice for everyday conversations.

observations.learnerText: El precio es de doscientos cincuenta euros
observations.correctedText: El precio es de doscientos cincuenta euros.
observations.outcome: Correct immediate construction of 250 after doscientos, cincuenta and a 230 model; no y between hundreds and tens.

observations.learnerText: el precio es de doscientos cincuenta y ocho euros
observations.correctedText: El precio es de doscientos cincuenta y ocho euros.
observations.outcome: Correct immediate construction of 258 after a 253 model and supplied ocho. Y correctly placed between tens and units; capitalization and punctuation normalized.

observations.tutorText: 200 = doscientos; 30 = treinta; 50 = cincuenta; 230 = doscientos treinta; 53 = cincuenta y tres; 253 = doscientos cincuenta y tres; eight = ocho.
observations.outcome: Models supplied. Treinta and tres were not attempted by learner; no independent retention assessment.

nextSteps: Recall crea ... para ... after intervening material; keep usted cree valid in formal contexts.
Revisit soporte técnico spelling without a fresh model.
Recall 250 and 258 after a gap, then broaden numbers for ordinary conversations; current evidence is immediate use after models.
assessmentNote: Immediate corrected reuse and successful transfer are evidence of practice, not durable mastery.
